correctness.rationale: Selecting the cone permits at most one path vertex. Omitting the cone reduces exactly to binary words on a path with no 111 factor. The suffix decomposition yields the stated recurrence, and a block decomposition of selected vertices yields the coefficient formula. The maximum size and multiplicities follow by substituting the extremal k into that exact coefficient formula. Exhaustive direct induced-degree checks through n=17 match all formulas.
